*Filtro de Dosificación*

Selecciona el rango de tiempo:

parameters.query: =WITH actual_logs AS (SELECT m.id, m.status::text AS status, m."scheduledAt", m.zones, COALESCE(a.name, 'Aplicación Manual') AS "agrochemicalName", COALESCE(a.preparation, '') AS preparation FROM "DosingLog" m LEFT JOIN "Agrochemical" a ON m."agrochemicalId" = a.id), routine_schedules AS (SELECT s.id, 'PENDING' AS status, NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days' AS "scheduledAt", s.zones, COALESCE(fa.name, pa.name, s.name) AS "agrochemicalName", COALESCE(fa.preparation, pa.preparation, '') AS preparation FROM "DosingSchedule" s LEFT JOIN "FertilizationProgram" fp ON s."fertilizationProgramId" = fp.id LEFT JOIN "FertilizationCycle" fc ON fc."programId" = fp.id AND fc.sequence = 1 LEFT JOIN "Agrochemical" fa ON fc."agrochemicalId" = fa.id LEFT JOIN "PhytosanitaryProgram" pp ON s."phytosanitaryProgramId" = pp.id LEFT JOIN "PhytosanitaryCycle" pc ON pc."programId" = pp.id AND pc.sequence = 1 LEFT JOIN "Agrochemical" pa ON pc."agrochemicalId" = pa.id WHERE s."isEnabled" = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "DosingLog" ml WHERE ml."scheduleId" = s.id AND ml.status = 'PENDING')), all_tasks AS (SELECT * FROM actual_logs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM routine_schedules) SELECT * FROM all_tasks WHERE ('{{ $json.statusPreset }}' = 'all' OR status = '{{ $json.statusPreset }}') AND ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'all' OR ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'today' AND "scheduledAt" >= CURRENT_DATE AND "scheduledAt" < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day') OR ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'week' AND "scheduledAt" >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) AND "scheduledAt" < date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 week') OR ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'next-week' AND "scheduledAt" >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 week' AND "scheduledAt" < date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '2 weeks') OR ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'month' AND "scheduledAt" >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND "scheduledAt" < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month') OR ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'next-month' AND "scheduledAt" >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' AND "scheduledAt" < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '2 months')) ORDER BY "scheduledAt" DESC LIMIT 10;
